title: EV Charger Installation Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original ev charger installation workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete ev charger installation customer request form for the electric vehicle charging site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The charging deployment coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: EV charger installation customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: EV charger installation requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: New workplace charging
Multifamily resident charging
Fleet depot charging
Public or customer charging
Existing charger replacement
Additional ports or power
Network or payment change
Fault, reliability, or access concern

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: EV charger installation condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: EV charger installation exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Exposed or damaged energized component, conductor, connector, or enclosure
Arcing, smoke, abnormal heat, burning odor, or repeated protective trip
Water intrusion, standing water, flood exposure, or damaged seals
Vehicle impact, unstable mounting, sharp edge, or falling equipment
Uncontrolled circuit, unknown backfeed, or incomplete energy isolation
Grounding, bonding, or protective-device result outside approved criteria
Pedestrian, accessible-route, traffic, or cord trip exposure
Work beyond the assigned qualified person's authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: EV charger installation decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric vehicle charging site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
